1   EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The discharging operation of three (3) packages of I-Beam and Steel Items (B/L WF03ZJGCON28Z, 11,020 KGS) was carried out at South Cargo Terminal, Berth 120, Constanța Sud. The operation was conducted under the attendance of the undersigned surveyor.

2   SCOPE OF SURVEY

The scope of survey was expressly limited to:

  • Determining the condition of cargo prior-discharging.
  • Supervision of handling operation during discharging.

4.2   Packing Description & Shipping Marks

The cargo was presented for discharge as three (3) packages of I-Beam and Steel Items under B/L WF03ZJGCON28Z, consisting of: one (1) I-Beam bundle (BOR-1289-a, Pkg. No. 1-1, bare bundle, 8,295 KGS gross), one (1) Stainless Steel Angle Steel and Channel Steel bundle (BOR-1289-b, Pkg. No. 1-2, bare bundle, 2,605 KGS gross), and one (1) Stainless Steel Pipe bundle (BOR-1289-c, Pkg. No. 1-3, bare bundle, 120 KGS gross).

All units were identified by shipping labels affixed to each unit, bearing case numbers, package numbers and packing list references. Shipping marks (BOR-1289-a/b/c) and cargo identification were found in accordance with the shipping documents.

6   PRE-CARRIAGE / STORAGE AFFORDED TO GOODS BEFORE DISCHARGING

6.1   Surveyor’s summary on pre-carriage transport conditions and exceptions

The cargo units were found stowed onboard the pre-carrying vessel MV 'WAN FU', voyage WF03, as follows:

Hold No. 5 — Lower Hold:

  • One (1) package (Pkg. No. 1-1) — I-Beam (BOR-1289-a), bare bundle — was stowed in the Lower Hold of Hold No. 5.
  • Cargo was secured / stowed as applicable.
  • Cargo unit was found in apparent good order and condition, properly secured.

Hold No. 1 — Lower Hold:

  • Two (2) packages (Pkg. No. 1-2 and 1-3) — Stainless Steel Angle Steel and Channel Steel (BOR-1289-b) and Stainless Steel Pipe (BOR-1289-c), bare bundles — were stowed in the Lower Hold of Hold No. 1.
  • Cargo was secured / stowed as applicable.
  • Cargo units were found in apparent good order and condition, properly secured.

7   PRE-DISCHARGE CARGO CONDITION SURVEY

All three (3) packages under B/L WF03ZJGCON28Z were stowed onboard MV ‘WAN FU’: Pkg. No. 1-1 in Hold No. 5 Lower Hold; Pkg. No. 1-2 and Pkg. No. 1-3 in Hold No. 1 Lower Hold. Cargo units were inspected from accessible positions. General rust / surface corrosion and dust accumulation were observed on exposed steel surfaces. No visible deformation, cracks or major structural damage noted where accessible.

7.1   Cargo operation description

Discharging was carried out using the vessel’s own cranes in Hold No. 1 Lower Hold and Hold No. 5 Lower Hold. Cargo units were lifted in single hook configuration using textile webbing slings and suitable shackles / connection points, as applicable. Lifting and landing were observed smooth and controlled, without abnormal handling or incidents.

7.2   Cargo lifting gear

  • 1 x Ship’s crane, marked as per visible crane marking.
  • Under-hook rigging provided by stevedores consisted of textile webbing slings and bow / connecting shackles, as applicable.
  • Cargo units were lifted in single hook configuration, with textile webbing slings arranged through / around the cargo units and connected under the ship’s crane hook.
  • Lifting gear and connection fittings appeared in serviceable condition at the time of inspection. No abnormal lifting, uneven lifting or improper handling was observed.

7.3   Lifting operation

  • Sufficient and qualified personnel were assigned, with clear lines of communication established between all parties involved.
  • Slinging arrangements, load balance and general stability were checked during lifting.
  • Lifting was smooth and controlled, with no rough handling, shock loading or cargo tilt noted.

7.4   Surveyor’s summary on cargo handling

The discharge and delivery operation of all three (3) packages under B/L WF03ZJGCON28Z was completed on 24 June 2026. Cargo units were found in apparent good order and condition. General rust / surface corrosion was observed on exposed steel members. No shortage or discrepancy was noted.
